# throng

> throng is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), themeable desktop workspace for people who live in the command line. Each project gets its own folder, colour and workspace of tabs, split into panels holding real terminals, a code editor, a live file tree and rendered Markdown previews. Terminals run in a background service, so closing the window never kills a build, a server or an AI agent. It runs on Windows 11 (x64), Linux (x64; apt and dnf repositories) and, at a best-endeavours level, macOS on Apple silicon.

The four headline features are projects and workspaces, panels (drag-to-split, with tabs torn off onto other monitors), persistent terminals that survive a restart with their scrollback, and an editor with live Markdown previews (Mermaid diagrams, wikilinks, an outline and synced scroll).

## Install

- [Installing on Windows](https://github.com/Bidthedog/throng/blob/master/docs/install-windows.md): setup .exe, MSI, portable build or zip; no administrator rights needed
- [Installing on Linux](https://github.com/Bidthedog/throng/blob/master/docs/install-linux.md): signed apt and dnf repositories on throng-ide.com, or a .deb, .rpm or tarball
- [Installing on macOS](https://github.com/Bidthedog/throng/blob/master/docs/install-macos.md): a .dmg for Apple silicon; not notarised, so the first launch needs Open Anyway
- [Releases](https://github.com/Bidthedog/throng/releases): every download, with SHA-256 checksums

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Bidthedog/throng/blob/master/README.md): what throng is and the full feature list
- [User guide](https://throng-ide.com/guide/): how to do each thing in throng, task by task
- [Quick start](https://throng-ide.com/guide/quick-start/): a tour from first launch to a working project
- [Key bindings](https://throng-ide.com/guide/reference/key-bindings/): every default chord, all rebindable
- [Preferences](https://throng-ide.com/guide/reference/preferences/): every setting, themes and icon sets
- [Theme settings](https://throng-ide.com/guide/reference/theme-settings/): every colour and font a theme sets
- [Sitemap](https://throng-ide.com/sitemap/): every page on this site
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Bidthedog/throng/blob/master/docs/architecture.md): the app, the background service and how they talk
